title: CoLMbo: Speaker Language Model for Descriptive Profiling

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing stacked confusion plots to evaluate prediction accuracy across regional dialects, identifying skew towards frequently represented classes (e.g., Northern or North Midland) over minority ones.
Evaluating model predictions across different racial/ethnic categories using confusion matrices to identify the tendency to over-predict the majority class (White) due to data skew.
Examining age prediction distributions via confusion plots to detect biases where the model disproportionately favors the most common age brackets (26–35 and 36–45) represented in the dataset.
Assessing prediction accuracy and misclassification overlap rates between male and female audio samples using confusion matrices.
